What is Yield Farming?

Published by TradeHQ. Site creator and editorial approach: Anuga Weerasinghe. This page has no recorded editorial review date.

DETAILED DEFINITION

Yield farming describes attempts to obtain fees, interest or token incentives through a DeFi arrangement. Liquidity provision, lending and a reward-token programme are different activities; their terms should not be treated as interchangeable. In the linked Uniswap v2 example, a liquidity provider owns a changing pool position and compares its value with holding the original tokens. Fee income and relative token-price changes both matter. An advertised annualised rate is a calculation under stated assumptions rather than a promise that the same rate persists or that a deposit gains value. Reward-token prices, contract failures, withdrawal restrictions and costs can change the outcome. Impermanent-loss arithmetic for a fee-free constant-product pool does not describe every protocol or concentrated range. Separate deposited quantities, rewards received, their valuation date and all costs in a hypothetical worksheet; more reward tokens can coincide with less total value. TradeHQ does not deposit funds into DeFi protocols or pay these rewards.

HOW IT WORKS

An informal term for seeking fees, interest or token incentives through DeFi protocols. Reward rates, token prices, withdrawal terms and contract risks affect the result.

KEY POINTS
Depositing crypto into protocols to earn fees, interest, or token rewards
High APYs often unsustainable and offset by IL and token depreciation
Smart contract risk means deposited funds can be lost to exploits
💡 WHY THIS MATTERS

Yield farming combines several risks, including changing incentives, token prices, contract failures and withdrawal conditions. A displayed reward rate is not the same as a guaranteed net return.

Worked exercise and its limits

Separate hypothetical fees, reward-token quantity and the reward token's price. Receiving more reward tokens can coincide with a lower total position value. Compare with holding under matching dates; TradeHQ does not deposit assets into DeFi protocols.

References and scope
Uniswap v2 — liquidity-provider returns and comparison with holding
